digest_method: drill-snapshot.sql: per-table SHA-256 over sorted row_to_json text, read as synveda_gateway with the tenant GUC under forced RLS; audit prefix digest over seq, prev_hash, hash, occurred_at, actor, action, resource, outcome, payload and trace_id for seq <= 313; ledger digest over version:checksum as the owner

pre_upgrade.verify: published v0.4.6 browser fixture `verify` passed (browser OIDC login and public-API receipt check)

timeline_utc: attempt 1: upgrade started from the v0.4.7 candidate bundle
writers-stopped: gateway, worker, realm convergence and Keycloak stopped with the v0.4.6 graph
backed-up: logical pair with the v0.4.6 PostgreSQL image and recovery utility

attempt 1 refused before any schema change: database-preflight reported that the migrator URL did not match the peer database cluster witness, because only the Synveda bootstrap had run on the recreated PostgreSQL. Fixed by also running keycloak-database-bootstrap; the database was unchanged
attempt 2 resumed at phase prepared; migration-check reported head 0010 upgradeable with no writes
migrating recorded; an owner session held ACCESS SHARE on public.scopes
the upgrade's migrator waited on the scopes lock; ledger still 10 rows
a competing published v0.4.7 migrate container started and waited on the SQLx advisory boundary
the upgrade's migrator container was killed during its lock wait; the action reported the after-schema-change direction (exit 78)
12 s later the killed client's server backend still waited on the relation lock and still held the boundary; the competitor still waited on the advisory lock
PostgreSQL restarted under the waiting competitor; the competitor exited 1 (terminating connection)
after restart: ledger 10 rows, marker 0010, 2 public views; every injected change rolled back
upgrade_with_injections.readiness_gap_note: includes the attempt-1 fix, the deliberate lock wait and the injected restart

same interrupted stamp: the v0.4.7 read-only check refused; the v0.4.7 migrator repaired only the stamp; digests unchanged
